CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_bind(i uuid, proof text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE w cv.auth_installation; BEGIN
 -- Serialize authentication administration in the same order as login, before identity locks.
 SELECT * INTO w FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR w.instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM i OR w.state<>'initialized'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.auth_session a JOIN cv.staff_session s
 ON (s.tenant_id,s.id)=(a.tenant_id,a.session_id) WHERE a.instance_id=i AND a.tenant_id=w.tenant_id
 AND s.token_digest=encode(sha256(convert_to(proof,'UTF8')),'hex')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM cv.bind_session(proof);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_bootstrap_admit(i uuid, proof text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE w cv.auth_installation; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO w FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR session_user<>'cv_runtime' OR w.realm IS DISTINCT FROM 'local'
 OR w.instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM i OR w.state<>'new' OR proof IS NULL
 OR w.startup_digest IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(proof,'UTF8')),'hex')
 OR w.startup_expires_at IS NULL OR w.startup_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.agency) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOTSTRAP_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Retain this lock in the service's hash/create transaction. The final create
 -- repeats proof, realm/state/empty-workspace and fresh expiry checks.
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_configure(r text, k text, p jsonb, startup cv.digest, secret text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE w cv.auth_installation; BEGIN
 IF session_user<>'cv_migrator' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPERATOR_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO w FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR w.state<>'new' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.agency)
 OR r NOT IN ('local','server') OR coalesce(btrim(k),'')='' OR p IS NULL
 OR coalesce(length(secret),0)<43 OR startup IS NULL
 OR coalesce((p->>'startup_ttl_seconds')::integer,0) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 900
 OR (w.realm IS NOT NULL AND (w.realm,w.realm_key,w.policy) IS DISTINCT FROM (r,k,p)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOTSTRAP_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 UPDATE cv.auth_installation SET realm=r,realm_key=k,policy=p,startup_digest=startup,
 startup_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>(p->>'startup_ttl_seconds')::integer),
 command_secret=coalesce(command_secret,secret) WHERE singleton;
 RETURN w.instance_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_current()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('instance_id',w.instance_id,'tenant_id',a.tenant_id,'user_id',a.user_id,
 'session_id',c.session_id,'login_name',u.login_name,'role',a.role,'expires_at',s.expires_at)
 INTO result FROM cv.current_authority() a JOIN cv.auth_installation w ON w.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 JOIN cv.transaction_context c ON c.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND c.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()
 JOIN cv.staff_user u ON (u.tenant_id,u.id)=(a.tenant_id,a.user_id)
 JOIN cv.staff_session s ON (s.tenant_id,s.id)=(c.tenant_id,c.session_id)
 JOIN cv.auth_session b ON (b.tenant_id,b.session_id,b.instance_id)=(s.tenant_id,s.id,w.instance_id);
 IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_descriptor(k text, r text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE w cv.auth_installation; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO w FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton;
 IF NOT FOUND OR (w.realm,w.realm_key) IS DISTINCT FROM (r,k) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('instance_id',w.instance_id,'state',w.state,'realm',w.realm,'realm_key',w.realm_key);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_policy_list(after_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE a jsonb; cap integer; result jsonb; BEGIN
 a:=cv.auth_current(); PERFORM cv.require_authority((a->>'tenant_id')::uuid,true);
 SELECT (policy->>'page_size')::integer INTO cap FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO result FROM (
  SELECT p.id,jsonb_build_object('policy_id',p.id,'kind',p.kind,'version',p.version,
  'owner_user_id',p.owner_user_id,'owner_role',p.owner_role,'expires_at',p.expires_at,
  'revoked',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.policy_revocation r WHERE (r.tenant_id,r.policy_id)=(p.tenant_id,p.id)),
  'definition',p.definition) value FROM cv.policy_version p WHERE p.tenant_id=(a->>'tenant_id')::uuid
  AND (after_id IS NULL OR p.id>after_id) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT cap
 ) bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_private_configuration(k text, r text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE w cv.auth_installation; BEGIN
 PERFORM cv.auth_descriptor(k,r);
 SELECT * INTO w FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('policy',w.policy,'command_secret',w.command_secret);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_staff_list(after_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE a jsonb; result jsonb; cap integer; BEGIN
 a:=cv.auth_current(); PERFORM cv.require_authority((a->>'tenant_id')::uuid,true);
 SELECT (policy->>'page_size')::integer INTO cap FROM cv.auth_installation WHERE singleton;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(cv.auth_staff_record(id) ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO result
 FROM (SELECT id FROM cv.staff_user WHERE tenant_id=(a->>'tenant_id')::uuid
 AND (after_id IS NULL OR id>after_id) ORDER BY id LIMIT cap) s;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.auth_staff_record(u uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE a jsonb; result jsonb; BEGIN
 a:=cv.auth_current(); PERFORM cv.require_authority((a->>'tenant_id')::uuid,true);
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('user_id',s.id,'login_name',s.login_name,'role',m.role,
 'active',s.active AND m.active,'revision',m.revision) INTO result
 FROM cv.staff_user s JOIN cv.membership m ON (m.tenant_id,m.user_id)=(s.tenant_id,s.id)
 WHERE s.tenant_id=(a->>'tenant_id')::uuid AND s.id=u;
 IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACCESS_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.bind_session(proof text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE s cv.staff_session; BEGIN
 SELECT ss.* INTO s FROM cv.staff_session ss
 JOIN cv.membership m ON (m.tenant_id,m.user_id)=(ss.tenant_id,ss.user_id)
 JOIN cv.staff_user u ON (u.tenant_id,u.id)=(m.tenant_id,m.user_id)
 WHERE ss.token_digest=encode(sha256(convert_to(proof,'UTF8')),'hex')
 AND ss.revoked_at IS NULL AND ss.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND m.active AND u.active
 FOR SHARE OF ss,m,u;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTH_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.transaction_context WHERE backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
 AND transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONTEXT_ALREADY_BOUND' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO cv.transaction_context VALUES(pg_backend_pid(),pg_current_xact_id(),s.tenant_id,s.id,s.user_id)
 ON CONFLICT(backend_pid) DO UPDATE SET transaction_id=excluded.transaction_id,
 tenant_id=excluded.tenant_id, session_id=excluded.session_id,user_id=excluded.user_id;
END $function$

 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
 SELECT cv.canonical_json_v1(jsonb_build_object(
 'identity_format','cv-calculation-v1',
 'jd',jsonb_build_object('version',j.version,'content',j.content),
 'rubric',jsonb_build_object('version',r.version,'definition',r.definition,
 'reference_date',r.reference_date,'criteria',(
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',c.criterion_key,'ordinal',c.ordinal,'weight',c.weight,
 'adapter',c.adapter,'mandatory',c.mandatory_definition) ORDER BY c.ordinal,c.criterion_key)
 FROM cv.rubric_criterion c WHERE (c.tenant_id,c.rubric_id)=(r.tenant_id,r.id))),
 'engine',jsonb_build_object('version',e.version,'definition',e.definition,
 'rounding',e.rounding,'unknown_rule',e.unknown_rule)))
 FROM cv.rubric_version r JOIN cv.jd_version j ON (j.tenant_id,j.position_id,j.id)=(r.tenant_id,r.position_id,r.jd_id)
 JOIN cv.engine_definition e ON (e.tenant_id,e.id)=(r.tenant_id,r.engine_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cv.evaluation_math_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'cv'
AS $function$
DECLARE e cv.evaluation; n integer; expected integer; missing integer; amount numeric; mandatory_value text; BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='evaluation' THEN
  SELECT * INTO e FROM cv.evaluation WHERE (tenant_id,scope_id,id)=(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.scope_id,NEW.id);
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO e FROM cv.evaluation WHERE (tenant_id,scope_id,id)=(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.scope_id,NEW.evaluation_id);
 END IF;
 IF e.state NOT IN ('complete','incomplete') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO expected FROM cv.rubric_criterion WHERE tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND rubric_id=e.rubric_id;
 SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.weight>0 AND c.rating IS NULL),sum(c.contribution),
 CASE WHEN bool_or(c.mandatory_status='fail') THEN 'fail'
 WHEN bool_or(c.mandatory_status='unknown') THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'pass' END
 INTO n,missing,amount,mandatory_value FROM cv.evaluation_component c
 WHERE (c.tenant_id,c.scope_id,c.evaluation_id)=(e.tenant_id,e.scope_id,e.id);
 IF n<>expected OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cv.evaluation_component c
 JOIN cv.rubric_criterion r ON (r.tenant_id,r.rubric_id,r.criterion_key)=(c.tenant_id,c.rubric_id,c.criterion_key)
 WHERE (c.tenant_id,c.scope_id,c.evaluation_id)=(e.tenant_id,e.scope_id,e.id)
 AND (c.weight<>r.weight OR (r.mandatory_definition IS NULL AND c.mandatory_status<>'pass')))
 OR e.mandatory_status<>mandatory_value
 OR (missing>0 AND e.state<>'incomplete') OR (missing=0 AND (e.state<>'complete' OR e.exact_total IS DISTINCT FROM amount))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVALUATION_OPERANDS_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

AS $function$

 FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object('document_content',x.content_digest,
 'extraction_definition',x.definition,'extraction_state',x.state,
 'semantic_evidence',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'page',e.page,'start',e.start_offset,'end',e.end_offset,'locator',e.semantic_locator,'text',e.text_content)
 ORDER BY e.page,e.start_offset,e.end_offset,e.semantic_locator,e.text_content)
 FROM cv.evidence_span e WHERE (e.tenant_id,e.scope_id,e.extraction_id)=(x.tenant_id,x.scope_id,x.id)),'[]'::jsonb),
 'reviewed_evidence',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fact',r.fact_key,
 'page',e.page,'start',e.start_offset,'end',e.end_offset,'locator',e.semantic_locator,'text',e.text_content)
 ORDER BY r.fact_key,e.page,e.start_offset,e.end_offset,e.semantic_locator,e.text_content)
 FROM cv.profile_evidence r JOIN cv.evidence_span e ON (e.tenant_id,e.scope_id,e.id)=(r.tenant_id,r.scope_id,r.evidence_id)
 WHERE (r.tenant_id,r.scope_id,r.profile_id,e.extraction_id)=(t,s,p,x.id)),'[]'::jsonb)) AS definition
 FROM cv.profile_source ps JOIN cv.extraction x ON

 HAVING count(*)>0
